all_tweets.description:
🚀 #TRON Cruza la Frontera Institucional con @Anchorage  Digital sumando soporte para $TRX

los activos digitales acaba de dar un giro determinante. Anchorage Digital, el primer y único banco de criptomonedas con licencia federal en los EE. UU. (OCC), ha anunciado oficialmente el soporte de custodia institucional para $TRX, el token nativo de la red TRON

Esta alianza no es solo una noticia técnica es la validación regulatoria que las instituciones financieras esperaban para interactuar con uno de los ecosistemas más activos del mundo

A diferencia de otros exchanges, Anchorage Digital opera bajo una carta bancaria nacional de la Oficina del Contralor de la Moneda (OCC)

Ofrece el nivel más alto de cumplimiento exigido por la SEC para asesores de inversión institucionales

Utiliza biometría y hardware de seguridad avanzada que elimina los riesgos de las "claves privadas" tradicionales

Permite que fondos de cobertura, bancos y tesorerías corporativas posean TRX sin salir del marco legal estadounidense

Con este soporte se habilitan pilares clave como.

Fondos de pensiones y dotaciones ahora tienen una vía "limpia" y auditada para adquirir exposición a TRX.

El anuncio inicial se centra en custodia, pero abre la puerta a futuras integraciones de Staking nativo y soporte para activos TRC-20, permitiendo que las instituciones participen en la gobernanza y generen rendimientos

Al ser aceptado por un banco con licencia federal, TRX se posiciona al mismo nivel de cumplimiento que activos como BTC o ETH en los balances institucionales

La llegada de TRX a Anchorage Digital marca el fin de la etapa de experimentación para TRON en los EE. UU. y el inicio de su fase como activo de grado institucional.

Para los inversores, esto significa mayor liquidez, menor volatilidad sistémica y una integración profunda con el sistema financiero tradicional. all_tweets.title: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs closed Q1 2026 with roughly $496 million in net outflows, their second-worst
all_tweets.description:
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs closed Q1 2026 with roughly $496 million in net outflows, their second-worst quarterly performance since launch.

Heavy redemptions characterized the first two months of the quarter, with $1.61B exiting in January and $207M in February, as Bitcoin fell nearly 24% for its worst Q1 since 2018.

Flows stabilized into quarter-end, with March delivering $1.32 billion in inflows, the first monthly gain since October 2025.

🇰🇿 بورصة كازاخستان تختار BitGo لبناء بنيتها التحتية للأصول الرقمية.

كازاخستان، الدولة التي تعمل على
all_tweets.description:
🇰🇿 بورصة كازاخستان تختار BitGo لبناء بنيتها التحتية للأصول الرقمية.

كازاخستان، الدولة التي تعمل على إنشاء صندوق سيادي بقيمة مليار دولار مدعوم بإيرادات تعدين #البيتكوين والأصول المُصادرة، قامت بتكليف شركة BitGo لتطوير بنيتها التحتية الرقمية.

هذا ليس مجرد تجربة من بورصة ناشئة؛ فبورصة KASE هي ثاني أكبر بورصة في دول الكتلة السوفيتية السابقة من حيث حجم تداول الأوراق المالية، وهذه الخطوة جزء من خطة أوسع بكثير.

حجم التداول على منصات الأصول الرقمية المنظمة في كازاخستان ارتفع من 280 مليون دولار في 2023 إلى 6.3 مليار دولار في أول ثلاثة أرباع من 2025، أي زيادة عشرين ضعفاً خلال أقل من عامين. وفي يناير، وقع الرئيس قاسم-جومارت توكاييف تشريعاً يمنح البنك الوطني لكازاخستان سلطة ترخيص البورصات والموافقة على الأصول الرقمية التي يمكن تداولها على المنصات المنظمة.

يعمل البنك المركزي على إنشاء خدمة حفظ وطنية للأصول الرقمية، من المتوقع إطلاقها بحلول مايو. وأفادت وكالة Reuters في وقت سابق من هذا الشهر أن البلاد تخطط لاستثمار ما يصل إلى 350 مليون دولار في الأصول الرقمية وإنشاء صندوق سيادي بقيمة تتراوح بين 500 مليون و1 مليار دولار، ممول جزئياً من الأصول المُصادرة وإيرادات التعدين.

كازاخستان كانت مركزاً رئيسياً لتعدين البيتكوين لسنوات، والآن تبني البنية المؤسسية لمواكبة ذلك. منصة BitGo، التي أصبحت أول شركة بنية تحتية للأصول الرقمية مُدرجة علنياً ومُرخّصة فدرالياً في يناير، ستوفر التخزين البارد، وحوكمة السياسات، وفصل الأصول للبورصة بموجب عقد يمتد لثلاث سنوات.

النمط واضح: دولة تلو الأخرى تبني بنية تحتية منظمة للأصول الرقمية بينما لا تزال الولايات المتحدة تناقش الأساسيات. وكلما طال فراغ التنظيم في واشنطن، زاد بناء هذه البنية التحتية في أماكن أخرى.

all_tweets.description:
Something important just happened around @trondao … and it’s easy to overlook if you’re only watching price charts.

𝗔𝗻𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗗𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 has officially added support for TRON.

At first glance, it sounds like another integration.
But it’s actually a strong signal about where things are heading.

Here’s why it matters.

Anchorage isn’t just any crypto platform. It operates as a federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., meaning it sits inside a regulated financial framework. 
That changes the context completely.

So when TRON gets supported here, it opens a different door:

→ Institutions can access TRON in a regulated environment

→ Custody of TRON-based assets becomes more compliant and secure.

→ Participation comes with clearer rules, not uncertainty

And that last part is key.

For years, institutional players have been interested in crypto… but hesitant. 
Not because of lack of opportunity, but because of unclear regulations and risk exposure.

Moves like this start to remove that friction.

Zooming out, this is how real adoption usually unfolds:

Retail activity builds momentum → Infrastructure matures → Institutions step in once the rails feel safe enough

This update pushes TRON further along that path.

It’s no longer just about high transaction volume or stablecoin dominance. 
It’s about being recognized within systems that institutions already trust and operate in.

And that’s a different level of positioning.

The interesting question now is what follows next.

Does this unlock more institutional capital into TRON?
Or is this just the first step before bigger integrations roll in?

Either way, it’s a signal worth paying attention to.

@justinsuntron #TRONEcoStar

all_tweets.title: Kazakhstan's stock exchange just tapped BitGo to build its digital asset infrastructure. The same co
all_tweets.description:
Kazakhstan's stock exchange just tapped BitGo to build its digital asset infrastructure. The same country building a $1 billion sovereign fund backed by bitcoin mining revenue and seized assets.

This isn't a startup exchange experimenting. KASE is the second-largest exchange in the former Soviet bloc by securities trading volume. And this move is part of a much larger play.

Kazakhstan's trading volume on regulated digital asset platforms went from $280 million in 2023 to $6.3 billion in the first three quarters of 2025. That's a twentyfold increase in under two years. In January, President Tokayev signed legislation giving the National Bank of Kazakhstan authority to license exchanges and approve which digital assets can be traded on regulated platforms.

The central bank is building a national custodial service, set to launch by May. Earlier this month, Reuters reported the country plans to invest up to $350 million in digital assets and establish a sovereign fund worth $500 million to $1 billion, funded in part by seized assets and mining revenue.

Kazakhstan has been a major bitcoin mining hub for years. Now it's building the institutional rails to match. BitGo, which became the first publicly traded, federally chartered digital asset infrastructure company in January, will provide cold storage, policy-based governance, and asset segregation for the exchange under a three-year deal.

The pattern is clear. Country after country is building regulated infrastructure for digital assets while the US still debates the basics. The longer the regulatory vacuum persists in Washington, the more of this infrastructure gets built elsewhere.

**Chainlink and Anchorage Digital Back New Crypto-Aligned PAC for US Midterms** 🗳️

**Chainlink Labs
all_tweets.description:
**Chainlink and Anchorage Digital Back New Crypto-Aligned PAC for US Midterms** 🗳️

**Chainlink Labs** and **Anchorage Digital** have joined as founding contributors to the **Blockchain Leadership Fund**, a hybrid political action committee (PAC) aimed at supporting candidates who advance pro-blockchain and digital asset policies ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections.

Key points:  
- The Blockchain Leadership Fund is a hybrid PAC that can make direct contributions to candidates as well as independent expenditures (such as media buys and advocacy campaigns).  
- It was launched in September with involvement from members of the advocacy group **The Digital Chamber**.  
- The PAC focuses on backing candidates who support key legislation, particularly the **CLARITY Act** (crypto market structure bill currently under Senate consideration).  
- A Chainlink spokesperson stated that candidates willing to support the CLARITY Act “deserve sustained, organized support from the industry.”  
- Anchorage Digital CEO **Nathan McCauley** emphasized: “2026 will be pivotal for crypto regulation. The choices we make now will shape the industry, and American financial leadership, for decades.”  
- Neither company disclosed specific contribution amounts. FEC records show no reported funding from the PAC between September and December 31, 2025. Anchorage noted it would use corporate resources for its support.  
- The effort builds on the 2024 elections, where over 270 pro-crypto candidates won seats and major PACs like **Fairshake** (backed by Ripple, Coinbase, and others) spent hundreds of millions. Fairshake currently holds over **$192 million** for the 2026 cycle.  
- The midterms on November 3, 2026, will determine control of the House and Senate, which is critical for advancing stalled bills like the CLARITY Act and the already-passed GENIUS Act.

This move signals continued and growing crypto industry investment in U.S. politics to secure favorable regulatory outcomes and long-term innovation.

Full story: https://t.co/Wi9CahQehq

#Chainlink #AnchorageDigital #CryptoPAC #BlockchainLeadershipFund #CLARITYAct #USMidterms #CryptoRegulation #DigitalAssets

🚨 CRYPTO: TETHER'S US-REGULATED STABLECOIN USA₮ EXPANDS TO CELO AS FIRST CHAIN BEYOND ETHEREUM

@tether's US-focused stablecoin $USAT, issued by federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank, has launched on Celo as its first blockchain expansion beyond Ethereum. The deployment taps into Celo's 4.23 million weekly active $USDT users and Opera MiniPay's 14 million registered wallets.

Google Cloud is providing faucet infrastructure for the rollout, while Self Protocol enables identity verification through biometric passports and OFAC sanctions screening via zero-knowledge proofs. @usat reserves are held with Cantor Fitzgerald in short-term US Treasury Bills, designed for GENIUS Act compliance.

all_tweets.description:
On March 29, Pharos Network announced that USDC and Circle’s CCTP will deploy on its upcoming mainnet. The stated goal is clear: make USDC a core settlement and collateral asset for RWAs, DeFi, and global payment flows, while using CCTP to connect Pharos natively to 20+ supported blockchains and 400+ secure transaction routes.  

That matters because this is not another vague “RWA future” post.
It is a concrete attempt to build a RealFi settlement layer around stablecoin settlement, cross-chain capital mobility, and compliance-oriented infrastructure.  

The bigger point: once stablecoins become the base layer for real-world financial assets, the real moat is no longer just the token. It is the process layer around movement, validation, routing, and execution. That is exactly why this direction is strategically relevant for infrastructure thinking around XGR / XDaLa too.  
https://t.co/Ds1j6liHt3

The problem:

The question: how long will people use 50-bank coordination when Circle and Bridge already move money faster, cheaper, and permissionlessly?

In the rapidly evolving landscape of digital assets, @FireblocksHQ has emerged as the definitive "infrastructure layer" for the global financial elite. Serving as the plumbing for over 2,500 institutions, Fireblocks provides the secure rails necessary to move value at the speed of the internet.     

   With over $10 trillion in transactions secured to date, the platform isn't just a wallet provider; it is an all-in-one operating system that allows banks, exchanges, and payment service providers to custody, settle, and issue digital assets with bank-grade security and regulatory compliance.  
                                          
✅ MPC-CMP Technology: Killing the "Single Point of Failure"Traditional private key management is a massive liability for banks—if a key is stolen or lost, the assets are gone. Fireblocks’ proprietary MPC-CMP (Multi-Party Computation) technology eliminates this risk by ensuring a private key is never created in a single location.

 Instead, mathematically generated "key shares" are distributed across multiple non-colluding nodes. This decentralized approach ensures that even if one part of the system is compromised, the assets remain untouchable.

2. The Global Payments Network: Replacing Legacy SettlementLegacy cross-border settlement is notoriously slow and expensive. Fireblocks is disrupting this via its Global Payments Network, which now processes over $200B in monthly stablecoin volume. 

By utilizing a high-speed stablecoin engine, institutions can bypass the friction of intermediary banks, achieving near-instant, 24/7/365 settlement for corporate treasury and merchant payouts.

3. Blockchain Agnostic Infrastructure: Unlimited ScalabilityFireblocks is built to be future-proof. Their infrastructure is strictly blockchain agnostic, recently expanding to support over 150+ public blockchains. 
This includes high-performance and specialized networks like Sui (for parallel execution), Monad (high-throughput EVM), and Canton (the privacy-enabled network for institutional finance). This allows clients to integrate once and access the entire ecosystem without re-architecting their security.                                          

  ✅Recent Updates & Strategic Milestones

Fireblocks continues to set the pace for institutional adoption through massive integrations and strategic growth:Acquisition of TRES Finance: In early 2026, Fireblocks acquired TRES Finance, a leader in Web3 accounting and financial data. This move integrates audit-ready reporting and tax compliance directly into the Fireblocks stack, creating a unified operating system for both "front-office" transfers and "back-office" reconciliation.Tier 1 Bank Partnerships: From BNY Mellon’s digital custody initiatives to Revolut’s crypto-offering and MoneyGram’s stablecoin-powered treasury flows, Fireblocks remains the  trusted partner for the world’s most regulated entities                                           

   💳 The Mastercard Connection: Bridging the Gap
A cornerstone of Fireblocks' vision is its role as a key member of the Mastercard Crypto Partner Program. This alliance is designed to merge the reliability of global card rails with the speed of blockchain.             By combining Fireblocks’ secure infrastructure with Mastercard’s massive merchant network, the partnership aims to bring programmable finance to B2B commerce. 

This means faster cross-border payments, more transparent supply chain financing, and the ability for consumers to spend digital assets as easily as fiat, all within a compliant and secure framework.

Learn more at:
https://t.co/U8CuKpyGnO

@TheDAOLabs

all_tweets.title:
📡 SIPO Signal｜Fireblocks × Cardano統合が進行中 — 機関カストディにConwayガバナンスが載った

Cardanoエコシステムの分散型ストレージプロジェクトIago
all_tweets.description:
📡 SIPO Signal｜Fireblocks × Cardano統合が進行中 — 機関カストディにConwayガバナンスが載った

Cardanoエコシステムの分散型ストレージプロジェクトIagonが、機関向けカストディ大手Fireblocksへの Cardano統合を進めていることを発表しました。SDKは3週間前からGitHubで公開されています。

🔗 https://t.co/ZbH3gWYO5G
🔗 https://t.co/vh994LpBG3

【Fireblocksとは何か】

Fireblocksは機関投資家向けデジタル資産インフラの最大手です。2,400社以上が利用し、累計$10兆以上の資産移転を処理してきました。

銀行、ヘッジファンド、取引所、決済企業が、暗号資産の保管・送受信・トークン化にFireblocksを使っています。MPC（マルチパーティ計算）による秘密鍵管理で、機関が求めるセキュリティ水準を満たすプラットフォームです。

ここにCardanoがネイティブ統合されるということは、機関がCardano資産を既存のインフラから直接管理できるようになることを意味します。

【SDKの中身が充実している】

公開されたSDKの機能リストを見ると、単なる「ADAの送受信」にとどまりません。

・ADA送受信（ネイティブ転送）
・CNT（Cardano Native Token）の単一・複数トークン転送
・Vault間転送（機関内部の資産移動）
・UTxO統合（ウォレット最適化）
・手数料見積もり
・トランザクション履歴・詳細取得
・ステーキング操作（ステークキー登録・プール委任・報酬引出し）
・プール情報照会（メタデータ・委任者・ブロック生成実績）

そしてここが最も注目すべき点ですが、Conway時代のガバナンス操作がフル実装されています。

・DRep登録（500 ADA デポジット）
・ガバナンスアクションへの投票（yes/no/abstain）
・DRepへの投票権委任

機関がFireblocksの管理画面から、DRepとして登録し、ガバナンス投票に参加できる設計です。

【なぜこれが重要なのか】

Cardanoのオンチェーンガバナンスは、現在コミュニティのDRepが中心です。しかしConway時代のガバナンスは「誰でもDRepになれる」設計であり、機関の参加も想定されています。

問題は「機関がどうやってガバナンスに参加するか」でした。機関は個人ウォレットでDRep登録するわけにはいきません。コンプライアンス、監査証跡、承認フロー、秘密鍵管理——すべてが機関グレードである必要があります。

Fireblocksの統合はこの問題を解決します。機関が既に使っているカストディインフラから、そのままCardanoのガバナンスに参加できる。技術的な障壁がなくなります。

【Iagonの役割】

このSDKはFireblocksのGitHub（fireblocks/cardano-raw-sdk）で公開されていますが、統合を主導しているのはCardanoエコシステムのIagonです。

IagonはCardano上の分散型ストレージ・コンピューティングプロジェクトで、Iagon APIがSDK内でバランス照会・トランザクション履歴・トークン操作のバックエンドとして使われています。エコシステムのプロジェクトが、機関インフラとの橋渡しを自ら構築している形ですね。

【Midnightと合わせて見る】

今日のMidnight Mainnetローンチでは、Google Cloud、Worldpay、MoneyGramなど9社がフェデレーテッドノードパートナーとして参加しました。

そしてFireblocksのCardano統合では、機関がADA保管・ステーキング・ガバナンスに参加するインフラが整いつつあります。

・Midnight → 機関が「プライバシーを保ちながら」ブロックチェーンを使える
・Fireblocks → 機関が「既存のカストディインフラから」Cardanoに参加できる

この2つが同時に進んでいることの意味は大きいです。機関がCardanoエコシステムに参入するための技術的障壁が、急速に取り除かれています。

SDKはオープンソースで公開済み。デモ動画も近日公開予定とのことです。

🔗 Iagon発表：https://t.co/ZbH3gWYO5G
🔗 GitHub SDK：https://t.co/vh994LpBG3
🔗 Fireblocks公式：https://t.co/4C0kNhrrB9

all_tweets.description:
Anchorage Digital Expands Institutional Crypto Access with TRON Integration

In a significant move for institutional blockchain adoption, Anchorage Digital, recognized as the first federally chartered crypto bank in the United States, has officially announced support for the TRON Network.

This integration marks a major milestone in bridging regulated financial infrastructure with high-performance blockchain ecosystems.

With this development, institutional clients can now securely custody TRX directly on Anchorage Digital’s compliant and federally regulated platform. Beyond custody, the integration opens the door for broader participation in the TRON ecosystem, enabling institutions to engage with one of the most widely utilized blockchain networks in the world while maintaining strict regulatory alignment.

 Why this matters:
Regulatory Confidence: TRON is now accessible within a U.S. federally regulated framework, a critical step for compliance-focused institutions.
Institutional-Grade Security: Anchorage Digital provides robust custody solutions designed for large-scale asset managers, fintech firms, and enterprises.

Expanded Ecosystem Access: Institutions can now seamlessly interact with TRON’s fast-growing infrastructure, including payments, stablecoins, and decentralized applications.

This move reinforces a broader industry trend: the convergence of traditional finance and blockchain technology under clear regulatory oversight. 
As institutional demand for secure and compliant crypto exposure continues to rise, integrations like this are setting the standard for the next phase of digital asset adoption.

According to a report by The Block, Anchorage Digital’s support for TRON positions it as the first federally chartered U.S. institution to bring TRON within the regulatory perimeter, a development that could accelerate institutional inflows into the network.

As blockchain infrastructure matures, partnerships between regulated custodians and leading networks like TRON are becoming essential. This collaboration not only enhances trust but also signals a future where compliance and decentralization can coexist at scale.

all_tweets.description:
One of their biggest strengths is the MPC-CMP technology. Instead of keeping private keys in one place (which creates a dangerous single point of failure that hackers love to target), Fireblocks splits the key across multiple independent parties and devices. 

No single breach can steal the funds. Their upgraded MPC-CMP version even signs transactions super fast - in just one round, while still letting institutions keep some keys offline for extra security. 

It’s built for banks that can’t afford mistakes.

This is a defining moment.

Not just access —
but recognition within regulated financial infrastructure.

Anchorage Digital becoming the first federally chartered U.S. firm to support TRON DAO effectively places TRON:

from external asset → recognized financial instrument

Institutions require:

➜ regulatory clarity
➜ qualified custody providers
➜ compliant operational pathways

With Anchorage:

➜ mandates can be executed legally

compliance risk

➜ capital can scale without structural friction

accessible → allocatable → scalable

We are seeing convergence across:

➜ custody (Anchorage)
➜ network infrastructure (TRON)
➜ capital (institutions)

regulated entry → on-chain participation → capital deployment

In the evolving world of digital finance, the battle for institutional trust is as crucial as network speed or user adoption. Today, Anchorage Digital—America’s first federally chartered crypto bank—takes a decisive step in that battle by embracing the TRON Network. This isn’t just an announcement; it’s a statement: TRON is no longer just a high-throughput blockchain favored by retail users and stablecoin transfers—it is now ready for the scrutiny, rigor, and capital of institutional players.

By integrating TRON, Anchorage is opening the door for regulated, institutional-grade custody of TRX, turning a widely used network into a bridge between traditional finance and the decentralized future.

▪️Institutional-Grade Validation for TRON

Anchorage Digital operates under a U.S. federal charter, placing it within a strict compliance and regulatory perimeter. By extending support to TRON, it effectively signals that the network meets a threshold of operational reliability, security architecture, and market relevance required for institutional participation.

For asset managers, hedge funds, and fintech platforms, this means:
➜ Qualified Custody: TRON assets can now be held by a regulated, trusted institution
➜ Regulatory Clarity: Institutional compliance risk is dramatically reduced
➜ Operational Confidence: Governance, security, and execution now meet professional standards

▪️Secure Custody for TRX

With this integration, institutions can securely store TRX on Anchorage’s regulated platform, gaining:
➜ Regulated Safekeeping: Compliance-backed custody within a federally chartered framework
➜ Advanced Security Architecture: Multi-layer hardware and governance protections
➜ Operational Efficiency: Simplified management of TRX exposure without fragmented systems

This elevates TRX from a retail-focused asset to an institutionally viable token.

▪️Strategic Implications for the TRON Ecosystem

TRON has long been a powerhouse for stablecoin transactions and high-volume transfers. Anchorage’s support now amplifies its institutional relevance:
➜ Institutional Onboarding: Easier access for large-scale capital
➜ Liquidity Expansion: More depth and stability in TRX markets
➜ Infrastructure Maturation: Alignment with regulated finance bridges traditional and decentralized ecosystems

▪️Bridging Traditional Finance and Blockchain

Anchorage’s move embodies the convergence of regulated finance and decentralized networks. By enabling secure, compliant access to TRON, it positions the network as a backbone for both high-volume crypto settlements and institutional-grade financial activity.

Conclusion 

Anchorage Digital’s support for TRON and TRX isn’t just an integration—it’s a milestone. It unlocks institutional participation, strengthens market liquidity, and positions TRON as a network capable of supporting the next wave of regulated, large-scale digital finance.

The integration
all_tweets.description:
Anchorage Digital Adds TRON Support Within a Federally Chartered Custody Framework

The integration of the TRON network into the custody services of Anchorage Digital reflects the extension of blockchain asset support into a regulated financial environment. Anchorage Digital operates as a federally chartered crypto bank in the United States, providing custody and infrastructure services for digital assets under established regulatory oversight.

This development places TRON assets within a custody framework that adheres to compliance standards associated with federally chartered institutions. Such institutions operate under defined regulatory supervision, with requirements covering asset safeguarding, operational controls, risk management, and reporting procedures. The inclusion of TRON within this environment allows institutional participants to access and hold TRON-based assets through a platform designed for regulated financial operations.

Custody solutions offered by federally chartered entities typically focus on secure storage of private keys, segregation of client assets, and protection against unauthorized access. These systems are designed to support institutional usage, where asset security, auditability, and operational reliability are essential components of service delivery.

The expansion of support for TRON within this context also aligns with broader trends in digital asset infrastructure, where blockchain networks are integrated into platforms that serve institutional clients. This integration supports standardized access to assets while maintaining alignment with compliance requirements applicable to regulated financial services providers.

The presence of TRON within Anchorage Digital’s custody framework establishes a channel through which institutional participants can interact with the network using infrastructure that operates under formal regulatory supervision, contributing to structured adoption within the digital asset ecosystem.

@justinsuntron @trondao #TRONEcoStar

Progress toward integrating blockchain networks into formal financial systems  

𝗕𝗼𝘁𝘁𝗼𝗺 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲

policy.title: Something important just happened around @trondao … and it’s easy to overlook if you’re only watchin
policy.description:
Something important just happened around @trondao … and it’s easy to overlook if you’re only watching price charts.

𝗔𝗻𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗗𝗶𝗴𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗹 has officially added support for TRON.

At first glance, it sounds like another integration.
But it’s actually a strong signal about where things are heading.

Here’s why it matters.

Anchorage isn’t just any crypto platform. It operates as a federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S., meaning it sits inside a regulated financial framework. 
That changes the context completely.

So when TRON gets supported here, it opens a different door:

→ Institutions can access TRON in a regulated environment

→ Custody of TRON-based assets becomes more compliant and secure.

→ Participation comes with clearer rules, not uncertainty

And that last part is key.

For years, institutional players have been interested in crypto… but hesitant. 
Not because of lack of opportunity, but because of unclear regulations and risk exposure.

Moves like this start to remove that friction.

Zooming out, this is how real adoption usually unfolds:

Retail activity builds momentum → Infrastructure matures → Institutions step in once the rails feel safe enough

This update pushes TRON further along that path.

It’s no longer just about high transaction volume or stablecoin dominance. 
It’s about being recognized within systems that institutions already trust and operate in.

And that’s a different level of positioning.

The interesting question now is what follows next.

Does this unlock more institutional capital into TRON?
Or is this just the first step before bigger integrations roll in?

Either way, it’s a signal worth paying attention to.

@justinsuntron #TRONEcoStar

policy.title: On March 29, Pharos Network announced that USDC and Circle’s CCTP will deploy on its upcoming mainne
policy.description:
On March 29, Pharos Network announced that USDC and Circle’s CCTP will deploy on its upcoming mainnet. The stated goal is clear: make USDC a core settlement and collateral asset for RWAs, DeFi, and global payment flows, while using CCTP to connect Pharos natively to 20+ supported blockchains and 400+ secure transaction routes.  

That matters because this is not another vague “RWA future” post.
It is a concrete attempt to build a RealFi settlement layer around stablecoin settlement, cross-chain capital mobility, and compliance-oriented infrastructure.  

The bigger point: once stablecoins become the base layer for real-world financial assets, the real moat is no longer just the token. It is the process layer around movement, validation, routing, and execution. That is exactly why this direction is strategically relevant for infrastructure thinking around XGR / XDaLa too.  
https://t.co/Ds1j6liHt3

los activ
company.description:
🚀 #TRON Cruza la Frontera Institucional con @Anchorage  Digital sumando soporte para $TRX

los activos digitales acaba de dar un giro determinante. Anchorage Digital, el primer y único banco de criptomonedas con licencia federal en los EE. UU. (OCC), ha anunciado oficialmente el soporte de custodia institucional para $TRX, el token nativo de la red TRON

Esta alianza no es solo una noticia técnica es la validación regulatoria que las instituciones financieras esperaban para interactuar con uno de los ecosistemas más activos del mundo

A diferencia de otros exchanges, Anchorage Digital opera bajo una carta bancaria nacional de la Oficina del Contralor de la Moneda (OCC)

Ofrece el nivel más alto de cumplimiento exigido por la SEC para asesores de inversión institucionales

Utiliza biometría y hardware de seguridad avanzada que elimina los riesgos de las "claves privadas" tradicionales

Permite que fondos de cobertura, bancos y tesorerías corporativas posean TRX sin salir del marco legal estadounidense

Con este soporte se habilitan pilares clave como.

Fondos de pensiones y dotaciones ahora tienen una vía "limpia" y auditada para adquirir exposición a TRX.

El anuncio inicial se centra en custodia, pero abre la puerta a futuras integraciones de Staking nativo y soporte para activos TRC-20, permitiendo que las instituciones participen en la gobernanza y generen rendimientos

Al ser aceptado por un banco con licencia federal, TRX se posiciona al mismo nivel de cumplimiento que activos como BTC o ETH en los balances institucionales

La llegada de TRX a Anchorage Digital marca el fin de la etapa de experimentación para TRON en los EE. UU. y el inicio de su fase como activo de grado institucional.

Para los inversores, esto significa mayor liquidez, menor volatilidad sistémica y una integración profunda con el sistema financiero tradicional. El ecosistema dirigido por @justinsuntron  y  @trondao  ha demostrado que la resiliencia y la infraestructura robusta son la clave para atraer al dinero inteligente

company.description:

Heavy redemptions characterized the first two months of the quarter, with $1.61B exiting in January and $207M in February, as Bitcoin fell nearly 24% for its worst Q1 since 2018.

Flows stabilized into quarter-end, with March delivering $1.32 billion in inflows, the first monthly gain since October 2025.

company.title:
🇰🇿 بورصة كازاخستان تختار BitGo لبناء بنيتها التحتية للأصول الرقمية.

كازاخستان، الدولة التي تعمل على
company.description:
🇰🇿 بورصة كازاخستان تختار BitGo لبناء بنيتها التحتية للأصول الرقمية.

كازاخستان، الدولة التي تعمل على إنشاء صندوق سيادي بقيمة مليار دولار مدعوم بإيرادات تعدين #البيتكوين والأصول المُصادرة، قامت بتكليف شركة BitGo لتطوير بنيتها التحتية الرقمية.

هذا ليس مجرد تجربة من بورصة ناشئة؛ فبورصة KASE هي ثاني أكبر بورصة في دول الكتلة السوفيتية السابقة من حيث حجم تداول الأوراق المالية، وهذه الخطوة جزء من خطة أوسع بكثير.

حجم التداول على منصات الأصول الرقمية المنظمة في كازاخستان ارتفع من 280 مليون دولار في 2023 إلى 6.3 مليار دولار في أول ثلاثة أرباع من 2025، أي زيادة عشرين ضعفاً خلال أقل من عامين. وفي يناير، وقع الرئيس قاسم-جومارت توكاييف تشريعاً يمنح البنك الوطني لكازاخستان سلطة ترخيص البورصات والموافقة على الأصول الرقمية التي يمكن تداولها على المنصات المنظمة.

يعمل البنك المركزي على إنشاء خدمة حفظ وطنية للأصول الرقمية، من المتوقع إطلاقها بحلول مايو. وأفادت وكالة Reuters في وقت سابق من هذا الشهر أن البلاد تخطط لاستثمار ما يصل إلى 350 مليون دولار في الأصول الرقمية وإنشاء صندوق سيادي بقيمة تتراوح بين 500 مليون و1 مليار دولار، ممول جزئياً من الأصول المُصادرة وإيرادات التعدين.

كازاخستان كانت مركزاً رئيسياً لتعدين البيتكوين لسنوات، والآن تبني البنية المؤسسية لمواكبة ذلك. منصة BitGo، التي أصبحت أول شركة بنية تحتية للأصول الرقمية مُدرجة علنياً ومُرخّصة فدرالياً في يناير، ستوفر التخزين البارد، وحوكمة السياسات، وفصل الأصول للبورصة بموجب عقد يمتد لثلاث سنوات.

النمط واضح: دولة تلو الأخرى تبني بنية تحتية منظمة للأصول الرقمية بينما لا تزال الولايات المتحدة تناقش الأساسيات. وكلما طال فراغ التنظيم في واشنطن، زاد بناء هذه البنية التحتية في أماكن أخرى.

النمط واضح: دولة تلو الأخرى تبني بنية تحتية منظمة للأصول الرقمية بينما لا تزال الولايات المتحدة تناقش الأساسيات. وكلما طال فراغ التنظيم في واشنطن، زاد بناء هذه البنية التحتية في أماكن أخرى.

company.title: Kazakhstan's stock exchange just tapped BitGo to build its digital asset infrastructure. The same co
company.description:
Kazakhstan's stock exchange just tapped BitGo to build its digital asset infrastructure. The same country building a $1 billion sovereign fund backed by bitcoin mining revenue and seized assets.

This isn't a startup exchange experimenting. KASE is the second-largest exchange in the former Soviet bloc by securities trading volume. And this move is part of a much larger play.

Kazakhstan's trading volume on regulated digital asset platforms went from $280 million in 2023 to $6.3 billion in the first three quarters of 2025. That's a twentyfold increase in under two years. In January, President Tokayev signed legislation giving the National Bank of Kazakhstan authority to license exchanges and approve which digital assets can be traded on regulated platforms.

The central bank is building a national custodial service, set to launch by May. Earlier this month, Reuters reported the country plans to invest up to $350 million in digital assets and establish a sovereign fund worth $500 million to $1 billion, funded in part by seized assets and mining revenue.

Kazakhstan has been a major bitcoin mining hub for years. Now it's building the institutional rails to match. BitGo, which became the first publicly traded, federally chartered digital asset infrastructure company in January, will provide cold storage, policy-based governance, and asset segregation for the exchange under a three-year deal.

The pattern is clear. Country after country is building regulated infrastructure for digital assets while the US still debates the basics. The longer the regulatory vacuum persists in Washington, the more of this infrastructure gets built elsewhere.

**Chainlink and Anchorage Digital Back New Crypto-Aligned PAC for US Midterms** 🗳️

**Chainlink Labs
company.description:
**Chainlink and Anchorage Digital Back New Crypto-Aligned PAC for US Midterms** 🗳️

**Chainlink Labs** and **Anchorage Digital** have joined as founding contributors to the **Blockchain Leadership Fund**, a hybrid political action committee (PAC) aimed at supporting candidates who advance pro-blockchain and digital asset policies ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections.

Key points:  
- The Blockchain Leadership Fund is a hybrid PAC that can make direct contributions to candidates as well as independent expenditures (such as media buys and advocacy campaigns).  
- It was launched in September with involvement from members of the advocacy group **The Digital Chamber**.  
- The PAC focuses on backing candidates who support key legislation, particularly the **CLARITY Act** (crypto market structure bill currently under Senate consideration).  
- A Chainlink spokesperson stated that candidates willing to support the CLARITY Act “deserve sustained, organized support from the industry.”  
- Anchorage Digital CEO **Nathan McCauley** emphasized: “2026 will be pivotal for crypto regulation. The choices we make now will shape the industry, and American financial leadership, for decades.”  
- Neither company disclosed specific contribution amounts. FEC records show no reported funding from the PAC between September and December 31, 2025. Anchorage noted it would use corporate resources for its support.  
- The effort builds on the 2024 elections, where over 270 pro-crypto candidates won seats and major PACs like **Fairshake** (backed by Ripple, Coinbase, and others) spent hundreds of millions. Fairshake currently holds over **$192 million** for the 2026 cycle.  
- The midterms on November 3, 2026, will determine control of the House and Senate, which is critical for advancing stalled bills like the CLARITY Act and the already-passed GENIUS Act.

This move signals continued and growing crypto industry investment in U.S. politics to secure favorable regulatory outcomes and long-term innovation.

Full story: https://t.co/Wi9CahQehq

#Chainlink #AnchorageDigital #CryptoPAC #BlockchainLeadershipFund #CLARITYAct #USMidterms #CryptoRegulation #DigitalAssets

company.description:
🚨 CRYPTO: TETHER'S US-REGULATED STABLECOIN USA₮ EXPANDS TO CELO AS FIRST CHAIN BEYOND ETHEREUM

@tether's US-focused stablecoin $USAT, issued by federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank, has launched on Celo as its first blockchain expansion beyond Ethereum. The deployment taps into Celo's 4.23 million weekly active $USDT users and Opera MiniPay's 14 million registered wallets.

Google Cloud is providing faucet infrastructure for the rollout, while Self Protocol enables identity verification through biometric passports and OFAC sanctions screening via zero-knowledge proofs. @usat reserves are held with Cantor Fitzgerald in short-term US Treasury Bills, designed for GENIUS Act compliance.

"USA₮ is designed to operate in environments where digital dollars are already being used at scale," said CEO Bo Hines, Trump's former top crypto official. Celo governance will propose enabling USA₮ and Tether Gold (XAU₮) as gas currencies following the launch.

In the rapidly evolving landscape of digi
company.description:
Fireblocks: The Institutional Backbone of Digital Finance

In the rapidly evolving landscape of digital assets, @FireblocksHQ has emerged as the definitive "infrastructure layer" for the global financial elite. Serving as the plumbing for over 2,500 institutions, Fireblocks provides the secure rails necessary to move value at the speed of the internet.     

   With over $10 trillion in transactions secured to date, the platform isn't just a wallet provider; it is an all-in-one operating system that allows banks, exchanges, and payment service providers to custody, settle, and issue digital assets with bank-grade security and regulatory compliance.  
                                          
✅ MPC-CMP Technology: Killing the "Single Point of Failure"Traditional private key management is a massive liability for banks—if a key is stolen or lost, the assets are gone. Fireblocks’ proprietary MPC-CMP (Multi-Party Computation) technology eliminates this risk by ensuring a private key is never created in a single location.

 Instead, mathematically generated "key shares" are distributed across multiple non-colluding nodes. This decentralized approach ensures that even if one part of the system is compromised, the assets remain untouchable.

2. The Global Payments Network: Replacing Legacy SettlementLegacy cross-border settlement is notoriously slow and expensive. Fireblocks is disrupting this via its Global Payments Network, which now processes over $200B in monthly stablecoin volume. 

By utilizing a high-speed stablecoin engine, institutions can bypass the friction of intermediary banks, achieving near-instant, 24/7/365 settlement for corporate treasury and merchant payouts.

3. Blockchain Agnostic Infrastructure: Unlimited ScalabilityFireblocks is built to be future-proof. Their infrastructure is strictly blockchain agnostic, recently expanding to support over 150+ public blockchains. 
This includes high-performance and specialized networks like Sui (for parallel execution), Monad (high-throughput EVM), and Canton (the privacy-enabled network for institutional finance). This allows clients to integrate once and access the entire ecosystem without re-architecting their security.                                          

  ✅Recent Updates & Strategic Milestones

Fireblocks continues to set the pace for institutional adoption through massive integrations and strategic growth:Acquisition of TRES Finance: In early 2026, Fireblocks acquired TRES Finance, a leader in Web3 accounting and financial data. This move integrates audit-ready reporting and tax compliance directly into the Fireblocks stack, creating a unified operating system for both "front-office" transfers and "back-office" reconciliation.Tier 1 Bank Partnerships: From BNY Mellon’s digital custody initiatives to Revolut’s crypto-offering and MoneyGram’s stablecoin-powered treasury flows, Fireblocks remains the  trusted partner for the world’s most regulated entities                                           

   💳 The Mastercard Connection: Bridging the Gap
A cornerstone of Fireblocks' vision is its role as a key member of the Mastercard Crypto Partner Program. This alliance is designed to merge the reliability of global card rails with the speed of blockchain.             By combining Fireblocks’ secure infrastructure with Mastercard’s massive merchant network, the partnership aims to bring programmable finance to B2B commerce. 

This means faster cross-border payments, more transparent supply chain financing, and the ability for consumers to spend digital assets as easily as fiat, all within a compliant and secure framework.

Learn more at:
https://t.co/U8CuKpyGnO

   With over $10 trillion in transactions secured to date, the platform isn't just a wallet provider; it is an all-in-one operating system that allows banks, exchanges, and payment service providers to custody, settle, and issue digital assets with bank-grade security and regulatory compliance.  
                                          
✅ MPC-CMP Technology: Killing the "Single Point of Failure"Traditional private key management is a massive liability for banks—if a key is stolen or lost, the assets are gone. Fireblocks’ proprietary MPC-CMP (Multi-Party Computation) technology eliminates this risk by ensuring a private key is never created in a single location.

 Instead, mathematically generated "key shares" are distributed across multiple non-colluding nodes. This decentralized approach ensures that even if one part of the system is compromised, the assets remain untouchable.

2. The Global Payments Network: Replacing Legacy SettlementLegacy cross-border settlement is notoriously slow and expensive. Fireblocks is disrupting this via its Global Payments Network, which now processes over $200B in monthly stablecoin volume. 

By utilizing a high-speed stablecoin engine, institutions can bypass the friction of intermediary banks, achieving near-instant, 24/7/365 settlement for corporate treasury and merchant payouts.

3. Blockchain Agnostic Infrastructure: Unlimited ScalabilityFireblocks is built to be future-proof. Their infrastructure is strictly blockchain agnostic, recently expanding to support over 150+ public blockchains. 
This includes high-performance and specialized networks like Sui (for parallel execution), Monad (high-throughput EVM), and Canton (the privacy-enabled network for institutional finance). This allows clients to integrate once and access the entire ecosystem without re-architecting their security.                                          

  ✅Recent Updates & Strategic Milestones

Fireblocks continues to set the pace for institutional adoption through massive integrations and strategic growth:Acquisition of TRES Finance: In early 2026, Fireblocks acquired TRES Finance, a leader in Web3 accounting and financial data. This move integrates audit-ready reporting and tax compliance directly into the Fireblocks stack, creating a unified operating system for both "front-office" transfers and "back-office" reconciliation.Tier 1 Bank Partnerships: From BNY Mellon’s digital custody initiatives to Revolut’s crypto-offering and MoneyGram’s stablecoin-powered treasury flows, Fireblocks remains the  trusted partner for the world’s most regulated entities                                           

   💳 The Mastercard Connection: Bridging the Gap
A cornerstone of Fireblocks' vision is its role as a key member of the Mastercard Crypto Partner Program. This alliance is designed to merge the reliability of global card rails with the speed of blockchain.             By combining Fireblocks’ secure infrastructure with Mastercard’s massive merchant network, the partnership aims to bring programmable finance to B2B commerce. 

This means faster cross-border payments, more transparent supply chain financing, and the ability for consumers to spend digital assets as easily as fiat, all within a compliant and secure framework.

company.title:
📡 SIPO Signal｜Fireblocks × Cardano統合が進行中 — 機関カストディにConwayガバナンスが載った

Cardanoエコシステムの分散型ストレージプロジェクトIago
company.description:
📡 SIPO Signal｜Fireblocks × Cardano統合が進行中 — 機関カストディにConwayガバナンスが載った

Cardanoエコシステムの分散型ストレージプロジェクトIagonが、機関向けカストディ大手Fireblocksへの Cardano統合を進めていることを発表しました。SDKは3週間前からGitHubで公開されています。

🔗 https://t.co/ZbH3gWYO5G
🔗 https://t.co/vh994LpBG3

【Fireblocksとは何か】

Fireblocksは機関投資家向けデジタル資産インフラの最大手です。2,400社以上が利用し、累計$10兆以上の資産移転を処理してきました。

銀行、ヘッジファンド、取引所、決済企業が、暗号資産の保管・送受信・トークン化にFireblocksを使っています。MPC（マルチパーティ計算）による秘密鍵管理で、機関が求めるセキュリティ水準を満たすプラットフォームです。

ここにCardanoがネイティブ統合されるということは、機関がCardano資産を既存のインフラから直接管理できるようになることを意味します。

【SDKの中身が充実している】

公開されたSDKの機能リストを見ると、単なる「ADAの送受信」にとどまりません。

・ADA送受信（ネイティブ転送）
・CNT（Cardano Native Token）の単一・複数トークン転送
・Vault間転送（機関内部の資産移動）
・UTxO統合（ウォレット最適化）
・手数料見積もり
・トランザクション履歴・詳細取得
・ステーキング操作（ステークキー登録・プール委任・報酬引出し）
・プール情報照会（メタデータ・委任者・ブロック生成実績）

そしてここが最も注目すべき点ですが、Conway時代のガバナンス操作がフル実装されています。

・DRep登録（500 ADA デポジット）
・ガバナンスアクションへの投票（yes/no/abstain）
・DRepへの投票権委任

機関がFireblocksの管理画面から、DRepとして登録し、ガバナンス投票に参加できる設計です。

【なぜこれが重要なのか】

Cardanoのオンチェーンガバナンスは、現在コミュニティのDRepが中心です。しかしConway時代のガバナンスは「誰でもDRepになれる」設計であり、機関の参加も想定されています。

問題は「機関がどうやってガバナンスに参加するか」でした。機関は個人ウォレットでDRep登録するわけにはいきません。コンプライアンス、監査証跡、承認フロー、秘密鍵管理——すべてが機関グレードである必要があります。

Fireblocksの統合はこの問題を解決します。機関が既に使っているカストディインフラから、そのままCardanoのガバナンスに参加できる。技術的な障壁がなくなります。

【Iagonの役割】

このSDKはFireblocksのGitHub（fireblocks/cardano-raw-sdk）で公開されていますが、統合を主導しているのはCardanoエコシステムのIagonです。

IagonはCardano上の分散型ストレージ・コンピューティングプロジェクトで、Iagon APIがSDK内でバランス照会・トランザクション履歴・トークン操作のバックエンドとして使われています。エコシステムのプロジェクトが、機関インフラとの橋渡しを自ら構築している形ですね。

【Midnightと合わせて見る】

今日のMidnight Mainnetローンチでは、Google Cloud、Worldpay、MoneyGramなど9社がフェデレーテッドノードパートナーとして参加しました。

そしてFireblocksのCardano統合では、機関がADA保管・ステーキング・ガバナンスに参加するインフラが整いつつあります。

・Midnight → 機関が「プライバシーを保ちながら」ブロックチェーンを使える
・Fireblocks → 機関が「既存のカストディインフラから」Cardanoに参加できる

この2つが同時に進んでいることの意味は大きいです。機関がCardanoエコシステムに参入するための技術的障壁が、急速に取り除かれています。

SDKはオープンソースで公開済み。デモ動画も近日公開予定とのことです。

🔗 Iagon発表：https://t.co/ZbH3gWYO5G
🔗 GitHub SDK：https://t.co/vh994LpBG3
🔗 Fireblocks公式：https://t.co/4C0kNhrrB9

company.description:
One of their biggest strengths is the MPC-CMP technology. Instead of keeping private keys in one place (which creates a dangerous single point of failure that hackers love to target), Fireblocks splits the key across multiple independent parties and devices. 

No single breach can steal the funds. Their upgraded MPC-CMP version even signs transactions super fast - in just one round, while still letting institutions keep some keys offline for extra security. 

It’s built for banks that can’t afford mistakes.

company.description:
Anchorage Digital – ngân hàng crypto được cấp phép liên bang đầu tiên của Mỹ – vừa chính thức hỗ trợ custody (lưu ký) TRX và staking trên mạng Tron. 

Đây là lần đầu tiên một công ty Mỹ được ủy quyền liên bang đưa toàn bộ mạng Tron “vào trong ranh giới quy định” (inside the regulatory perimeter) của Hoa Kỳ.

Điểm nổi bật:

- Anchorage hỗ trợ lưu ký $TRX trên nền tảng chính và ví tổ chức Porto, đồng thời sẽ triển khai dần các token TRC-20 (bao gồm USDT trên Tron – hiện có 84 tỷ USD).
- Điều này giúp các tổ chức tài chính Mỹ (hedge fund, treasury…) có thể tiếp cận Tron một cách an toàn, hợp quy mà trước đây gần như không thể do lo ngại quy định.
- @justinsuntron  và Nathan McCauley (CEO Anchorage) đều phát biểu tích cực, coi đây là bước quan trọng giúp mở rộng tiếp cận tổ chức cho hệ sinh thái Tron.

Ý nghĩa:Đây là cột mốc quy định lớn cho @trondao , giúp giảm rào cản và mở đường cho dòng vốn tổ chức Mỹ chảy vào mạng Tron (một trong những blockchain có USDT lớn nhất thế giới).Tin này khá bullish vì lần đầu tiên Tron được một ngân hàng liên bang Mỹ chính thức công nhận và hỗ trợ hạ tầng.

regulated entry → on-chain participation → capital deployment

In the evolving world of digital finance, the battle for institutional trust is as crucial as network speed or user adoption. Today, Anchorage Digital—America’s first federally chartered crypto bank—takes a decisive step in that battle by embracing the TRON Network. Anchorage Digital Adds TRON Support Within a Federally Chartered Custody Framework

The integration of the TRON network into the custody services of Anchorage Digital reflects the extension of blockchain asset support into a regulated financial environment. Anchorage Digital operates as a federally chartered crypto bank in the United States, providing custody and infrastructure services for digital assets under established regulatory oversight.

This development places TRON assets within a custody framework that adheres to compliance standards associated with federally chartered institutions. Such institutions operate under defined regulatory supervision, with requirements covering asset safeguarding, operational controls, risk management, and reporting procedures. The inclusion of TRON within this environment allows institutional participants to access and hold TRON-based assets through a platform designed for regulated financial operations.

Custody solutions offered by federally chartered entities typically focus on secure storage of private keys, segregation of client assets, and protection against unauthorized access. These systems are designed to support institutional usage, where asset security, auditability, and operational reliability are essential components of service delivery.

The expansion of support for TRON within this context also aligns with broader trends in digital asset infrastructure, where blockchain networks are integrated into platforms that serve institutional clients. This integration supports standardized access to assets while maintaining alignment with compliance requirements applicable to regulated financial services providers.

The presence of TRON within Anchorage Digital’s custody framework establishes a channel through which institutional participants can interact with the network using infrastructure that operates under formal regulatory supervision, contributing to structured adoption within the digital asset ecosystem.

It begins with infrastructure that satisfies regulatory, security, and operational requirements.  

That foundation is now in place.  

With Anchorage Digital, the first federally chartered crypto bank in the United States, integrating TRON, the network gains more than exposure:  
a compliant, institutional-grade access layer into one of the most active blockchain ecosystems globally.  

This is not a growth announcement.  
It is infrastructure alignment at the highest level of financial trust.  

𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗮𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝘁𝗼 𝗮𝗹𝗹𝗼𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 - 𝘄𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝘀  

For the first time, institutions can engage with TRON through a regulated custody framework purpose-built for professional capital.  

Now live:  

➜ Secure custody support for TRX  
➜ Alignment with U.S. compliance and regulatory standards  
➜ Institutional-grade security, governance, and operational infrastructure  

Next phase (in development):  

➜ Support for TRC-20 assets  
➜ Native TRX staking within compliant frameworks  
➜ Deeper integration into validator participation and network activity  

This shifts TRON from being accessible to being allocatable, a key requirement for institutional portfolios.  

𝗪𝗵𝘆 𝗔𝗻𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗲𝗿  

Institutional capital does not directly interact with blockchain environments.  
It moves through trusted, regulated intermediaries.  

Anchorage Digital operates at that intersection:  

➜ Federally chartered crypto bank in the U.S.  
➜ Backed by institutions including Goldman Sachs, Visa, and Andreessen Horowitz  
➜ Built to deliver custody, staking, governance, and settlement at institutional scale  

By integrating TRON, Anchorage connects high-throughput blockchain infrastructure with regulatory-grade financial systems. 

𝗧𝗥𝗢𝗡’𝘀 𝗽𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 - 𝘀𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆  

TRON enters this phase as a proven settlement layer:  

🌐 372M+ user accounts  
⚡ 13B+ transactions processed  
🔄 10M+ daily transactions  
💵 85B+ USDT circulating on-chain  

These metrics reflect sustained, real-world usage, particularly in stablecoin payments and cross-border transfers.  

The missing component has been institutional access within a compliant framework.  

That gap is now being addressed.  

𝗔 𝗯𝗿𝗼𝗮𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗳𝘁 𝗶𝗻 𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗲𝗻𝗴𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁  

The market is transitioning from speculative participation to structured capital deployment.  

Institutions are no longer asking whether to engage with blockchain networks.  
They are identifying which networks meet their standards.  

This integration signals:  

➜ TRON infrastructure is ready for institutional workflows  
➜ Compliance, custody, and scalability can coexist within its ecosystem  
➜ Capital that remained on the sidelines now has a clear entry point  

As emphasized by Justin Sun, trusted infrastructure is the foundation for deeper institutional participation.  

𝗦𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗴𝗶𝗰 𝗶𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀  

➜ For institutions  
A regulated and secure gateway into a high-activity blockchain ecosystem  

➜ For TRON  
Alignment with U.S. financial infrastructure and institutional capital channels  

➜ For the broader market  
Progress toward integrating blockchain networks into formal financial systems  

𝗕𝗼𝘁𝘁𝗼𝗺 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲  

This integration is not about short-term expansion.  
It is about long-term credibility and capital alignment.  

🔐 Regulated custody is established  
🏛️ Institutional participation is enabled  
🌍 Network activity continues to scale  

TRON is evolving beyond a high-usage network into one institutions can formally trust, access, and allocate into.  

#TRONEcoStar @justinsuntron @trondao
